movelist.name: Worry Seed
movelist.effect: You choose one of the target’s Abilities. Worry Seed changes that Ability to Insomnia for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Petal Dance
movelist.effect: After damage is dealt, the user becomes Enraged and Confused.

movelist.name: Growth
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage. If it is Sunny, double the amount of Combat Stages gained.

movelist.name: Sweet Scent
movelist.effect: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

movelist.name: Razor Leaf
movelist.effect: Razor Leaf is a Critical Hit on 18+.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.effect: The user gains Last Chance with Grass.

abilities.name: Discipline
abilities.effect: If the user gains initiative and is Confused, Enraged, Infatuated, or Flinched, they may activate Discipline to cure themselves of any of these conditions.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.effect: The user may use a self-targeting Status-Class Move as a Free Action.
